effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
[When Attacking] If this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, it may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name or the [NSo] or [VB] trait in the trash with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Gabumon]/[Garurumon] in name or w/[NSo]/[VB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
xros_req:
[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Garurumon] in name or w/[NSo]/[VB] trait: Cost 3 
[DNA Digivolve] Blue/Yellow Lv.5 + Purple/Red Lv.5 : Cost 0
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
